image_id.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the source image record

md5_hash.description: 128-bit cryptographic MD5 checksum for data lineage

rgb_r_mean.description: First-order mean intensity of the Red channel

rgb_g_mean.description: First-order mean intensity of the Green channel (chlorophyll indicator)

rgb_b_mean.description: First-order mean intensity of the Blue channel

rgb_r_std.description: Standard deviation of the Red channel (color variance)

rgb_g_std.description: Standard deviation of the Green channel

rgb_b_std.description: Standard deviation of the Blue channel

rgb_r_norm.description: Normalized Red intensity in unit range [0, 1]

rgb_g_norm.description: Normalized Green intensity in unit range [0, 1]

rgb_b_norm.description: Normalized Blue intensity in unit range [0, 1]

hsv_h_norm.description: Normalized Hue angle in unit range [0, 1]

exg_index_mean.description: Excess Green Index (2G - R - B) for vegetative foliar contrast

dominant_color_tone.description: Categorical dominant tone (e.g. Foliar_Green, Brown_Blight, Yellowish_Lesion)

glcm_contrast.description: Haralick contrast: measures intensity contrast between pixel pairs

glcm_contrast_norm.description: Normalized GLCM contrast scaled by maximum theoretical pair distance

glcm_dissimilarity.description: Linear difference between adjacent pixel gray levels

glcm_homogeneity.description: Measures closeness of element distribution to diagonal (local uniformity)

glcm_energy.description: Angular Second Moment (ASM): measures orderliness of textural patterns

glcm_correlation.description: Linear dependency of gray levels of neighbor pixels

glcm_asm.description: Sum of squared elements in GLCM (equals energy)

has_valid_contour.description: Flag indicating whether a distinct pathological lesion contour exists

contour_area.description: Pixel area of the segmented lesion region

contour_perimeter.description: Boundary perimeter in pixels of the segmented lesion

contour_solidity.description: Area fraction of lesion relative to its bounding envelope

lesion_coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of total leaf foliage affected by lesion spots
